findings.issue: עשתי (cardinal singular construct) plus עשר (cardinal) license eleven, and חדש is absolute with no article; «el mes undécimo» turns that compound into an ordinal, adds a definite article, and places the noun before the number.
אחד is an absolute cardinal with no article; «el» before «uno» is grammatical smoothing.

notes: «cuarenta año» keeps the cardinal and the singular noun.
